<div class="flourish-embed flourish-chart" data-src="visualisation/25418005?515064"><script src="https://public.flourish.studio/resources/embed.js"></script><noscript><img src="https://public.flourish.studio/visualisation/25418005/thumbnail" width="100%" alt="chart visualization" /></noscript></div>
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis
csv_name <- "chartbook_F14.csv"
csv_tmp  <- file.path(tempdir(), csv_name)
download.file(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GPID-WB/pip-chartbook/refs/heads/main/csv/chartbook_F14.csv",
  destfile = csv_tmp,
  mode = "wb",
  quiet = TRUE
)
# Plain <a download> holding the CSV as a data: URI.
# downloadthis::download_file() is deliberately NOT used here: the handler it
# generates calls fetch() on the data: URI, and PositConnect serves a
# Content-Security-Policy whose connect-src has no data:, so the fetch was
# blocked and the button failed with "Download failed. Please try again."
# An anchor download is not governed by any CSP directive.
cat(sprintf(
  '<div class="cell-output-display"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="data:text/csv;base64,%s" download="%s"><i class="bi bi-download"></i> Download data as csv</a></div>',
  xfun::base64_encode(csv_tmp), csv_name
))
```

<p style="font-size: 0.5em; color: #555; margin-top: 0.5em;">

Note: PPP$ = purchasing power parity dollars. This figure shows the distribution of the population over income and consumption levels in 1990, cut off at 25 dollars per person per day and expressed in 2021 PPP dollars.

</p>
